episodes.title: Fall
episodes.summary: Livia Drusilla loses everything in the Civil War as her father and husband find themselves defeated and forced into exile.

episodes.title: Rise
episodes.summary: When an amnesty is declared, a pregnant Livia returns to Rome to rebuild her family fortunes and save her friend.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.summary: Now in her thirties, Livia finds herself married to Gaius and pregnant again, and Gaius and Agrippa are alone at the top of the world, ruling Rome together as consuls.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.summary: Livia's marriage to Gaius is compromised when she learns that she cannot bear him any children.

episodes.title: Plague
episodes.summary: Livia returns to a Rome overrun with plague, and the question of who will succeed a gravely ill Gaius becomes an urgent matter.

episodes.title: Nightshade
episodes.summary: Two months after the plague rescinds, Livia's boys are still in danger. Marcellus is surrounded by the same powerful friends who plotted to assassinate Agrippa, Tiberius and Drusus.

episodes.title: Treason
episodes.summary: As Gaius' rivals taste blood in the water, Livia must outwit both them and her husband if the family is to be kept together.

episodes.title: Happiness
episodes.summary: As Livia tells her sons about their role in her Mission, the truth behind her part in Marcellus' death threatens to come out.

episodes.title: Conspiracy
episodes.summary: Livia and Gaius return to famine in Rome. Gaius starts a succession race.

episodes.title: Wedding
episodes.summary: Drusus and Antonina's wedding is threatened. Livia's marriage is tested.

episodes.title: Betrayal
episodes.summary: Livia and Gemina come face to face with life-changing consequences. Drusus' military career is in danger.

episodes.title: Exile
episodes.summary: Livia's missed in Rome, and must deal with a threat to her sons and secure Gaius' forgiveness.

episodes.title: Sacrilege
episodes.summary: Gaius' plans for the succession shock Livia. Tiberius grows suspicious of Gaius.

episodes.title: Freedom
episodes.summary: Shocking news brings instability to Rome. Livia must make a dangerous choice.

episodes.title: Curse
episodes.summary: Livia is threatened on her way to a wedding and has to make a life-threatening decision.

episodes.title: Control
episodes.summary: Livia must reassert control of the family. News from Germany has devastating consequences.
